headline: The phone picks up a mouth: TALK ME DOWN gets typed calls
lede: The defuser's vocabulary used to need a mic on phones or a keyboard on desktops. Now a thumb can WRITE the call: a TYPE pill opens the soft keyboard straight into the game's own CALL line, one grammar and one bank away from the mic. A shelf-wide weakest-game scan named the target; the fix is pinned by a new 39-gate phone drive.

notes.text: TALK ME DOWN (#2287, slot a): TYPE pill during play on touch surfaces — a real <input> focuses, the soft keyboard rises, and the words feed the same canvas CALL line X made on desktop (#1894): same tick law, same 28-char cap, GO shouts through voiceCall. Phones stop being mic-only.

Words are not hands, so the law wears two belts: the input stops its own key propagation AND the global handlers refuse INPUT targets. Without them, typing "CUT BLUE" presses the pad's B and every space presses A. QA found a third door mid-build — keyup — a released B stamped b_rel on the pad while typing; keyup is guarded now too.

New gate: npm run tmdphonecheck — 39 gates at 390x844 with real taps and keystrokes, plus a desktop control page (no pill there, X byte-as-before). Mutant proof: pull both belts and 11 gates go red — leaked Escape pauses mid-typing and the shout doubles in the bank.
Side win: bombdrive died at the auto-record consent gate on boxes where the rec store is live — seeded the honest DECLINED answer per the #2095 parity law. 63/0 again.
